spec_refs: PLAN D2 (no namespaces; Landlock ABI >= 4 else refuse), D4 (<=20 unsafe sites), D5 (filter layout)

acceptance.cmd: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2 ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p p2-subject && oracles/syscall-negative/run --subject 'target/p2/release/p2-subject probe' && oracles/syscall-negative/run --self-test --subject 'target/p2/release/p2-subject probe' && cargo xtask unsafe-sites
acceptance.must: PASS on the laptop (6.17.0-14); every probe killed with SIGSYS (clone3: ENOSYS) for zygote child and cordon; PR_GET_DUMPABLE = 0 in every process; Landlock ABI detected and recorded; aegis-iso unsafe sites <= 20 with // SAFETY:

notes: The gate also probes the real worker (target/p2-test aegis-p2 probe, test-hooks); that half becomes runnable with P5-iso-002 (forkwasm) and P5-iso-003 (cordon), whose acceptance runs it. API: sandbox::Profile {zygote, child, cordon} -> install(&Profile) -> Result<Installed, SandboxError> (NO_NEW_PRIVS, Landlock fs ro on given paths + net deny, seccomp per D5, dumpable 0, rlimits NOFILE/NPROC/CORE=0); fails closed if any step fails. p2-subject is path-only (aegis-iso, later aegis-wasm); no direct third-party deps.
